title: Plugin sandbox egress is SSRF-exposed: allow-list may be '*' and requests are not restricted to public https after DNS resolution
test_evidence: Base re-verification: egress-policy.ts already implements the full fail-closed SSRF policy (assertSafeAllowedHosts rejects '*'/empty; assertEgressAllowed requires the host on the explicit allow-list AND assertPublicHttpsUrlDefault from @proctira/common/safe-fetch, blocking metadata/loopback/private/link-local + non-https + redirects) and is already wired into in-process-sandbox.ts and plugin-sandbox.ts. Existing in-process-sandbox.security.test.ts covers the M628 scenarios and PASSES on the base source (evidence/M628-base-stale.log, 6/6, exit 0).
notes: STALE: SSRF egress bridge was built by B01/M602 (sandbox/egress-policy.ts) on which this batch stacks; a test that already passes on base is not a new proof (design 1). No code change.

title: Parked plugin register/install lifecycle has no role guard: any authenticated caller can register or install a plugin
test_evidence: Commit 81e5d1fa. Failing-first (revert proof) evidence/M603-M627-fail.log: non-admin mutations returned 200 on base instead of 403 (3 failed/4 passed, exit 1); with fix 7/7 pass. plugin package 159/159; tsc exit 0.
notes: New in-package authz.ts: assertCanRegisterPlugin (platform admin only) + assertCanManageInstallation (tenant/board admin or platform admin) via canonical @proctira/common role sets; PluginForbiddenError -> 403. Package stays parked/unmounted; no new dependency.

title: Plugin install validates that consent covers requiredPermissions but does not cap it, so an install can grant more than the manifest asks
test_evidence: Commit 14079368. Failing-first evidence/L479-fail.log: over-broad consent accepted (201) on base instead of 422 (exit 1); with fix 422 BUSINESS_RULE_ERROR.
notes: Consent ceiling added in plugin-service.install: any consented permission not in the plugin's requiredPermissions is rejected with BusinessRuleError (422), complementing the existing covers-required check.

title: Plugin audit attributes the actor to the literal 'system' and has no injectable durable audit sink
test_evidence: Commit 4d301867. Failing-first evidence/L477-fail.log: base records 'system'/no injected port; a no-sub register returned 201 instead of 401 (exit 1); with fix 401 ACTOR_REQUIRED + injected port carries real actor+tenant.
notes: New audit-port.ts (PluginAuditPort interface + PluginActorRequiredError 401); plugin-service routes all 6 lifecycle audit events through the injected port when present (else repository fallback, behaviour-preserving). routes.ts requireActor removes the 'system' fallback (401 when no verified sub). Dependency inversion; no new package dependency.

title: Tenant isolation: a tenant admin can author a platform-scope policy that applies across every tenant via the inheritance chain
test_evidence: Commit 683ce0cc (shared). Failing-first evidence/M606-M609-M630-M610-fail.log: a tenant admin could create a platform-scope policy / assign to the platform target on base (exit 1); with fix both are 403.
notes: assertCanAuthorScope restricts scope=='platform' authorship (create, editing an existing platform-scope policy, assigning to the platform target) to platform admins; tenant admins -> 403. Scope is immutable on update, so the update guard reads the stored policy's scope. Tenancy/RLS specialist sign-off is a merge condition.

title: Parked policy writes no audit for lifecycle mutations and takes no actor (companion to L477, policy side)
test_evidence: Commit 46e09163. Failing-first (revert proof) evidence/M608-fail.log: base writes no audit row and a no-sub create returned 201 instead of 401 (2 failed, exit 1); with fix 401 ACTOR_REQUIRED and an injected port records every lifecycle event with the real actor+tenant (evidence/M608-pass.log). policy package 80/80; tsc exit 0.
notes: New audit-port.ts (PolicyAuditPort interface + PolicyActorRequiredError 401); PolicyService records create/update/activate/deactivate/assign/removeAssignment through an injected port carrying the real actor (verified sub) and tenant; policy-plugin threads the optional auditPort. routes.ts requireActor fails closed (401) when no verified sub so no 'system'-attributed or tenant-less row is ever written. When no port is injected nothing is emitted (behaviour-preserving). Dependency inversion; no new package dependency.
